mainEntity.name: What services does Lutherwood offer for children and youth with mental health challenges?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lutherwood offers live-in treatment and assessment services, family crisis and prevention counselling, and community and school-based interventions.

mainEntity.name: What is Front Door and how can it help with mental health challenges?

acceptedAnswer.text: Front Door is the first place to go for information, assistance, and to access services when a child or youth is experiencing mental health, emotional or behavioral challenges.
Lutherwood’s Crisis Services include Mobile Crisis Services (MCS), Safe Haven Youth Services (SHYS), and Emergency Department Diversion Team (EDDT).

mainEntity.name: What community services does Lutherwood offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lutherwood offers a range of community services including Front Door, Partners Program, Community Mental Health Intensive (CMHI), Connect Parent Group, Brief Community Mental Health Services (BCMH), Children’s Mental Health Systems Advisor (CMHSA), Intensive Support & Resource Coordination Program (ISRCP), Health Connect, and Youth Justice Services.

mainEntity.name: What is the Intensive Support and Supervision Program (ISSP)?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ISSP is a youth justice service offered by Lutherwood that provides individualized support and supervision for youth involved in the justice system.

mainEntity.name: What are the Day Treatment and Live-in Programs?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Day Treatment and Live-in Programs offered by Lutherwood provide treatment and support for children and youth with mental health challenges in a structured and supportive environment.

mainEntity.name: Does Lutherwood offer services for families?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Lutherwood offers services for families, including family crisis and prevention counselling and the Connect Parent Group.

about_blocks.text: If you or a loved one is struggling with mental health, Lutherwood is a non-profit rehab center located in Waterloo, Ontario that specializes in treating mental health issues. We understand the difficulties that come with mental illness and aim to provide personalized care to each individual. Our team of licensed professionals is committed to helping you on your journey to recovery.

We understand the difficulties that come with mental illness and aim to provide personalized care to each individual. Our team of licensed professionals is committed to helping you on your journey to recovery.

about_blocks.text: At Lutherwood, we offer a wide variety of therapies, including evidence-based practices, individual therapy and counseling, family therapy and counseling, group therapy and counseling, nutritional counseling, art therapy, and nature therapy. Our holistic approach to treatment includes implementing a combination of therapies that will work best for you. We believe in utilizing evidence-based practices while also incorporating alternative therapies that are proven to be effective.

about_blocks.text: Our center also provides family services and outpatient drug rehab programs for those who need help with substance abuse. about_blocks.text: Lutherwood is a leading rehab center that has been providing effective mental health, employment, and housing services to residents of Waterloo Region and Wellington County for over 50 years. As a not-for-profit organization, Lutherwood is focused on strengthening people’s lives and ensuring that everyone has access to the support they need to thrive. Lutherwood is dedicated to meeting the needs of diverse communities, including BIPOC, 2SLGBTQ+, and other marginalized groups that have been disproportionately impacted by discrimination.

about_blocks.text: Lutherwood’s Children’s Mental Health Services are nationally accredited and have been trusted by children, youth, and their families since 1970 to provide the support they need to cope with serious emotional and behavioral challenges. Lutherwood’s preventative and supportive services are delivered by qualified professionals who use proven practices to help families cope with life’s challenges. Lutherwood was also selected in 2014 as the Lead Agency responsible for planning, access, and quality of children’s mental health services across Waterloo Region, ensuring that children and youth have access to the highest possible quality of care.
